steps.title: Analyze and Classify Build Failure
steps.description: Review the build logs and identify layout resource errors and illegal external dependencies.

steps.title: Correct Layout Resource Dimensions
steps.description: Fix layout_width typo in activity_main.xml, ensuring all dimensions are set to valid standard attributes.

steps.title: Remove Unused Prohibited Dependencies
steps.description: Clean app/build.gradle by removing nanohttpd external dependency to adhere to SDK-only rules.

steps.title: Validate Android Manifest Namespace
steps.description: Verify the correct Android schemas namespace declaration in the AndroidManifest.xml file.

steps.title: Verify Application Icon Configuration
steps.description: Confirm launcher icons point to the correct drawable/icon path instead of mipmaps.

steps.title: Check Java Compilation Text Sizes
steps.description: Ensure text dimensions in MainActivity.java are initialized with standard integer points.

steps.title: Enforce Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review Java source code to ensure that no lambda expressions or streams are utilized.

steps.title: Audit Shared Preferences Storage
steps.description: Verify JSON serialization parameters for saving and loading custom cards locally.

steps.title: Verify PDF Document Export Engine
steps.description: Ensure graphics drawing methods and PDF page specifications are optimized for target environment.

steps.title: Synchronize Build Environment Parameters
steps.description: Verify compile SDK, target SDK, and build tools match Gradle environment settings.

steps.title: Building Quiz Card Creator
steps.description: Execute the debug compilation build cycle using gradle assembleDebug and generate the final package.
